endorsements.name: Hashim Jawad
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25307
endorsements.description: SysGauge Pro 4.6.12 contains a local buffer overflow vulnerability in the Register function that allows local attackers to overwrite the structured exception handler by supplying a crafted unlock key. Attackers can inject shellcode through the Unlock Key field during registration to execute arbitrary code with application privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.6)

endorsements.name: Hashim Jawad
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25313
endorsements.description: SysGauge 4.5.18 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the proxy configuration handler that allows local attackers to cause a denial of service by supplying an oversized string. Attackers can inject a large payload through the Proxy Server Host Name field in the Options menu to crash the application.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)

endorsements.name: Hashim Jawad
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25344
endorsements.description: 10-Strike Network Inventory Explorer 8.54 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the registration key input field that allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code by triggering a structured exception handler overwrite. Attackers can craft a malicious registration key string with 4188 bytes of padding followed by SEH chain values and shellcode, then paste it into the registration dialog to achieve code execution with application privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.6)

endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25345
endorsements.description: 10-Strike Network Scanner 3.0 contains a local buffer overflow vulnerability in the host name field that allows attackers to bypass SafeSEH protections and execute arbitrary code.
